analysis:
Examined the head tail of EngineV2Bridge+Submission.swift (lines 539-995), the Translation constant addition, and the usage-signal rename/addition.

Submission: the new typed refusal (nativeOutputControlRefusal, lines 965-994) is a pre-engine client-error check. It runs before shared-KV and prefix-cache reservation; per the patch, the early refusal calls usageSignal.finalizeLookup(.policy) and continuation.finish(), then throws .unsupportedOutputControl. Resources are not yet acquired at that point, so no leak is visible. A new catch in the non-throwing path converts it to an .error event. The remaining visible submission flow (shared KV reservation, first-content deadline check, retirement transfer, releasePreSubmitResources, pump ownership of prefix receipts) appears unchanged in this PR. These paths affect T-041 SSD staging/receipt release, but I identified no new leak or ordering regression in the visible lines.

Translation: the added unsupportedOutputControlPrefix string is a constant only. The mapping in MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineError.fromSchedulerMessage lies outside the supplied evidence. If that mapping is missing, the error would be classified as a generic failure rather than 400. That is an availability/breaker-classification concern, not a confidentiality one.

UsageSignal: the rename to firstWithheldOutputAt and the new recordWithheldOutput() are lock-protected timing metadata. They do not store answer text; only a timestamp is recorded. No plaintext exposure is added (A-001, T-008 unaffected). Callers of the renamed property were not supplied; a compile-level or semantic mismatch is possible but is not a security issue.

No prompt content is logged in the changed code. The refusal messages are static. Remaining integration questions: confirm that fromSchedulerMessage maps the new prefix, that all callers of the renamed property are updated, and that the throw at the early refusal precedes any prefix-cache staging in the throwing submit path (lines ~150-157 are only visible in the patch).
